items.title: Interactive Brokers Group (IBKR) Opens Global Equity Access For Korean Investors
items.summary: Interactive Brokers Group (NasdaqGS:IBKR) announced a new collaboration with Daol Investment & Securities to support Korean investor access to global equities. The partnership will use Interactive Brokers' trading infrastructure to streamline cross border investing for Daol clients. The arrangement is intended to support white label use of IBKR's technology by Daol and create a longer term two way investment channel between Korea and overseas markets.
